chosen_by.rationale: An unconfirmed limit is safer small, and raising a ceiling later is easier than lowering one: a job that has been running inside 8 h for a month makes 2 h look like a regression, while 2 h that turns out to pinch is one edit. Replaces the 4 h the design discussion had proposed.
Tighter than the 20 GB proposed, for the same reason as the wall clock: nothing was measured, and an unconfirmed ceiling is safer small.
A smoke run that may spend the full budget tells you nothing before the run it is supposed to precede, so this is a ceiling in its own right and not a fraction of the one above.
Same reason as the smoke wall clock: the run that calibrates the cost model must be cheap before the model is trusted.
